name: NeRF Volumetric Rendering (Coarse/Fine Sampling)
definition: A volumetric rendering method that estimates RGB color, depth, and opacity along rays by sampling a neural network at discrete points, converting raw outputs to alpha values, and performing differentiable integration (sum of weighted colors).
summary: NeRF Volumetric Rendering (Coarse/Fine Sampling) is a differentiable rendering method that reduces aliasing and noise by using a two-stage strategy: a coarse network estimates density distribution, and a fine network samples densely around high-density regions to refine the output.
